race.description: Clubs Queensland Awards For Excellence Hcp (Bm70)
race.comment: ENTERPRISE LUCIA (3) is a proven fresh performer and resumes with two smart trials under her belt. The form around him last time in reads strongly for this and he rates a strong chance. KING OF MINTO (6) also returns and is unbeaten fresh. Still relatively lightly raced and boasts strong peaks. Will bounce straight to the front and prove hard to hold out. COINCIDE (9) was beaten just over a length by FIREFORCE at Ipswich and now gets weight relief plus a claim. Great chance to turn the tables and get back in the winner's circle. FIREFORCE (5) gets the chance to rebound after a luckless Eagle Farm run where he jumped awkwardly and raced wide throughout. His Ipswich win prior was a much better read on him, where he beat Vin Santo. Graham reuniting fourth-up also reads favourably. YOSHINO (1) resumes and will appreciate the easier assignment. Has been fitted with a soft trial but will need a clever steer from out there and has to carry the big weight.
